card.fromOperator: Set by the operator. You may use another address.
card.how: “Connect” opens {partner}. You sign in there, see what both apps get from each other, and agree. Then you are back here.
card.unreachableText: You see the state of {when}. {app} asks again on its own; the connection stays as it is.
card.refusedText: It was ended in {partner}. Until you connect again, {app} lacks what comes from there.
card.restingText: Your account in {partner} rests, or the connection was not used for half a year. “Renew” wakes it.
card.offText: The operator of {partner} has switched connections with other nex apps off. Nothing is deleted.
card.expiringText: Connect once more. Afterwards the connection keeps itself fresh, and you never enter a key again.
card.legacyText: Connected with an API key you entered by hand. It keeps working as before.
card.tooOld: {partner} at this address cannot connect this way yet. Connect by hand or ask the operator for an update.
card.notSetUpTitle: {partner} is not set up on this server
card.notSetUpText: The operator enters the address of {partner} once under Server › General › Other nex apps. Then you connect here with one click.
card.notSetUpOperator: Enter the address of {partner} under Server › General › Other nex apps. Then every account connects here with one click.
card.localOffTitle: {app} does not ask addresses in the local network
card.localOffText: {partner} is at an address in the local network. The operator has to allow that first: Server › General › Other nex apps, “Connections into the local network”.
card.tooOldMember: {partner} at this address cannot connect this way yet. Ask the operator to update {partner}.
card.sendsPerson: For this, {app} sends {partner} the name, mail addresses and phone numbers of the contact you look at in {app}, only when you open it.
card.receivesPerson: For this, {partner} sends {app} the name, mail addresses and phone numbers of the contact you look at in {partner}, only when you open it.

disconnect.title: Disconnect {partner}?
disconnect.text: Both directions end, in {app} and in {partner}. What you created yourself stays in both apps.

consent.title: {partner} wants to connect with {app}
consent.subtitle: {partner} at {host} and {app} then get their own access to each other.
consent.replaces: An earlier connection with {partner} is replaced.
consent.footer: You can disconnect at any time under My account › Connections, here or in {partner}.
consent.broken: This request is incomplete. Start connecting again in the other app.

operator.title: Other nex apps
operator.subtitle: How the apps of this server connect with each other.
operator.switchHint: Off: nobody connects anew, existing connections rest. Nothing is deleted.
operator.addressesHint: An address set here is prefilled in the card for every account.
operator.localHint: Other nex apps may also be at an address in the local network (LAN, VPN). Then every account can have {app} ask addresses there.

failed: That did not work. Try again in a moment.

errors.partner_unknown: {app} does not connect with this app.
errors.address_invalid: This is not an address of a nex app.
errors.address_port: {app} asks only on port 80, 443 or from 1024 on.
errors.wrong_app: Another app answers at this address.
errors.partner_too_old: The app at this address cannot connect this way yet. Connect by hand.
errors.partner_off: The operator of the other app has switched connections off.
errors.unreachable: The other app cannot be reached right now.
errors.refused: The other app no longer accepts the connection.
errors.resting: The other app lets the connection rest.
errors.consent_failed: The other app did not confirm the connection. Connect again.
errors.slow_down: Too many tries. Wait a minute.
errors.return_invalid: This return belongs to no connection started here. Connect again.
errors.connections_off: The operator has switched connections with other nex apps off.
errors.client_invalid: The app that asks cannot be checked.
errors.redirect_invalid: This return address does not belong to the app that asks.
errors.pkce_required: The app that asks must use PKCE with S256.
errors.areas_invalid: One of them is not yours.
errors.local_off: {app} asks addresses in the local network only once the operator allows it: Server › General › Other nex apps, “Connections into the local network”.
errors.partner_not_set_up: {partner} is not set up on this server. The operator does that under Server › General › Other nex apps.
errors.declined: You turned the connection down in {partner}.
errors.partner_local_off: {partner} does not ask {app}, because the address of {app} lies in the local network. The operator has to allow that in {partner} first: Server › General › Other nex apps, “Connections into the local network”.
errors.partner_cannot_reach: {partner} cannot reach {app} right now. If it stays so, the operator checks the address of {app} in {partner} under Server › General › Other nex apps.
errors.about_unknown: This app tells nothing about people for that.
errors.person_invalid: Name a person by name, mail address or number, within the limits.

nextasks.tasks.read: Read your tasks and those assigned to you
nextasks.members.read: See the members of your spaces
nextasks.tasks.about: Find open tasks about a contact (only title and due date)

nextime.events.about: Find events with a contact (only title and time)

nexpaper.deadlines.read: Read the deadlines of your documents
nexpaper.documents.about: Find documents from a contact (only title and date)

nexmail.mails.about: Count mails with a contact (never what they say)

about.nexnotes+nextasks: Lines of a note as tasks, with a link back.
about.nexmail+nextasks: Mails as tasks; ticks and due dates come back.
about.nextasks+nextime: Tasks with a due date in the calendar, ticked off in the calendar.
about.nexpaper+nextime: Deadlines from documents as all-day entries.
about.nexmail+nextime: Calendars in nexmail, events from mails, answering invitations.
about.nexfolk+nextime: Birthdays as a calendar, guests from contacts, the next event in the contact.
about.nexfolk+nexmail: Contacts while writing, new addresses into the address book, the number of mails in the contact.
about.nexmail+nexpaper: Attachments of mails as documents in the inbox.
about.nexpaper+nextasks: Tasks from documents, with a link back.
about.nexlore+nexnotes: Notes into the knowledge of nexlore.
about.nexdiary+nextime: The day's events in the review of the day.
about.nexdiary+nextasks: The day's finished tasks in the review of the day.
about.nexdiary+nexfolk: People from your contacts in the entry.
about.nexnotes+nextime: A note for the event in your inbox.
about.nexfolk+nextasks: The open tasks about the person in the contact.
about.nexfolk+nexpaper: The person's documents in the contact.
